lead.headline: Tuten is questionable — and your lineup has no net under him
lead.deck: He was limited Wednesday. Move him to FLEX and Gordon to RB so Diggs can step in at 13:55.
lead.body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten was limited on Wednesday with his ankle and foot, and ESPN now lists him questionable. After this afternoon's lineup change he sits in an RB slot with Diggs in FLEX, and every back on your bench kicks off at 12:00 — so if Jacksonville declare him inactive at 13:55, nobody can replace him. Put Gordon in an RB slot and Tuten in FLEX: it is the projection lineup, and Diggs (Monday) or Waddle (15:25) become live fallbacks. Waddle practised for the first time since his concussion but is not cleared; Geno Smith, Wilson's quarterback, was limited.
